content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6-2.2 g of protein per kg of bodyweight per day. Research shows gains level off around 1.6 g/kg, and the higher end is useful if you're in a calorie deficit or want a margin of safety. 💪 Spread it over 3-5 meals with roughly 0.3-0.4 g/kg each, and keep total calories at or slightly above maintenance for your 100 kg bench goal.

If you tell me your bodyweight, I'll work out your daily number.
